description:
Nahla (Holly Hunter) and The Doctor (Robert Picardo) take Sam (Kerrice Brooks) to The Makers to determine what's causing her glitches. The Doctor shares his past and the story of losing his daughter, and Nahla suggests that they may be able to save Sam by giving her a childhood with The Doctor acting as her parent. Season 1, Episode 8
